name: hud_ui_message_box_dialog_on_cancel
description: HudUiMessageBoxDialog::OnCancel stores the cancel modal result and clears the modal countdown.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4bf7e0 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bf7e0 validates modalResult = 2 at offset 0xa95c and modalFrameCountdown = 0 at offset 0xa960.
The native message-box leaf smoke verifies OnCancel updates both fields.
